keeps_row.instructions: Does the text say that the failed input keeps its row in the output?

na_answers.instructions: Does the text say that the answers of the failed row are NA?

error_text.instructions: Does the text say that the reason of the failure is in the .error column?

others_continue.instructions: Does the text say that the other inputs of the batch still get their answers?

stops_all.instructions: Does the text say that decide() stops with an error, or returns nothing, when one call fails?

drops_row.instructions: Does the text say that decide() removes the failed input from the output?
